# Building blocks

Components that work anywhere. Each folder holds one component with its own stylesheet, a demo file and a README, and needs only a `Theme` above it.

| Component | What it is |
|---|---|
| [Heading, Text, Link](Text) | The type scale and the accent link. |
| [TextField](TextField) | A 49px text input with a floating label. |
| [SelectField](SelectField) | A native select dressed as a text field. |
| [FieldError](FieldError) | The message that opens under a field. |
| [Checkbox](Checkbox) | A native checkbox under an 18px drawn box. |
| [Radio](Radio) | The bare radio used inside `ChoiceList`. |
| [ChoiceList](ChoiceList) | Radio rows joined into one rounded box, used for shipping rates, pickup locations and payment methods. |
| [SegmentedControl](SegmentedControl) | A switch between a few options. |
| [Button](Button) | Two styles, both from the checkout: the 50px primary button, and the quiet apply button that stays grey until it has something to do. |
| [Spinner](Spinner) | A 2px round-capped arc on a 1.6s loop. |
| [Tooltip, InfoButton](Tooltip) | A near-black bubble with white 12px text, up to 190px wide, with a small arrow. |
| [Combobox](Combobox) | A text field with an async suggestion list. |
| [Collapsible](Collapsible) | Opens and closes content over 200ms by animating a grid row from 0fr to 1fr, so nothing is measured in JavaScript. |
| [ContentSwap](ContentSwap) | Swaps content in place. |
| [Reveal](Reveal) | Content that rises 10px and fades in over 400ms. |
| [Skeleton](Skeleton) | A grey placeholder with 6px corners that pulses to half opacity on a 1.35s loop. |
| [Banner](Banner) | The critical message shown when a payment fails. |
| [Tag](Tag) | A grey chip with a price-tag icon, used for an applied discount code. |
| [Divider](Divider) | A 1px line in the border colour, optionally with grey text centred on it. |
| [Modal](Modal) | A dialog up to 600px wide over a 60% black backdrop. |
| [Card](Card) | The bordered container the thank-you page is built from: 1px border, 12px corners, 16px padding in the body. |
| [Thumbnail](Thumbnail) | A 64px frame for a product image: 16px corners, 2px white border, hairline shadow. |
| [Stack, FieldGrid](Layout) | The form’s spacing. |
| [Field](Field) | Shared by other components; see its README. |
